game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Camel Trail, a camel trail: the oasis keeper must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Validation Fortress: Write input checks that reject bad data so scarab swarms can't sneak through.
theme: Sand Dunes – Camel Trail: a camel trail
core_gameplay_loop: In Camel Trail, repeat each round: Write input checks that reject bad data so scarab swarms can't sneak through. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the fortress value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the caravan wagon using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The caravan wagon reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the caravan wagon is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 2 (intro tier): Validation Fortress
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Validation Fortress' (Week 9 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Camel Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fortress changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against scarab swarms in Camel Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The caravan wagon reached with actions_used <= 11.
